question:
What is the central angle corresponding to the sector indicating the expenses incurred on Health?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a9faef92bea56d2a44bff6bf54b2693c67e6fc5a06deeb8d8a960c52961347.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

The central angle corresponding to the sector indicates the expenses incurred on Health:

⇒ 50000 → 360°

⇒ 15000 → (360°/50000) × 15000

⇒ 15000 → 36 × 3

⇒ 15000 → 108°

**The central angle corresponding to the sector indicates the expenses incurred on Health is 108°.**
